text:
Court of King’s Bench of Alberta

Citation: Belanger (Re), 2024 ABKB 449

Date:
20240722

Docket:
2401 05651

Registry:
Calgary

Between:

ATB Financial

Applicant

- and -

Edward Jay Robin Belanger

Respondent

_______________________________________________________

Memorandum of Decision

of the

Associate Chief Justice

D.B. Nixon

_______________________________________________________

I.          Introduction

[
1
]

Edward Jay Robin Belanger [“Belanger”] is an abusive litigant and promoter of “Organized Pseudolegal Commercial Arguments” [“OPCA”], a category of not-law concepts identified by Associate Chief Justice Rooke in the frequently referenced
Meads v Meads
,
2012 ABQB 571
[
Meads
] decision. Belanger is the founder and central figure of the Church of the Ecumenical Redemption International, a fake church that he invented to provide a theoretical (or theological) foundation for his claims. He invented this entity after Courts rejected his earlier demands for special legal immunities because he is a “Reformed Druid”:
Meads
at paras
134-139, 183-188
. I refer to this individual as “Belanger” because he objects to “titles”. Instead, Belanger self-identifies, as a “minister” (always with a lower case “m”), but that appellation is not appropriate, since this Court has repeatedly concluded that CERI is nothing more than a fabricated non-religion: e.g.,
Potvin (Re)
,
2018 ABQB 652
;
CP (Re)
,
2019 ABQB 310
at paras
33-34
;
CP (Re)
,
2019 ABQB 388
at para
14
;
ATB Financial v Dimsdale Auto Parts Ltd
,
2024 ABKB 143
at paras
25-26
[
Dimsdale #1
].

[
2
]

Belanger’s court misconduct and abusive litigation ranges across Canada and in the Federal Courts. I previously reviewed Belanger’s abusive conduct in
Dimsdale #1
at paras
22-26
. Donald J Netolitzky, “Jesus Built My Strawman: The Church of the Ecumenical Redemption International and “minister” Edward Jay Robin Belanger” (2023) 6 International Journal of Coercion, Abuse, and Manipulation, DOI: 10.54208/1000/0006/004, online (pdf):
ResearchGate
<www.researchgate.net/publication/370057527_Jesus_Built_My_Strawman_The_Church_of_the_Ecumenical_Redemption_International_and_minister_Edward_Jay_Robin_Belanger> [Netolitzky, “Strawman”] further examines and details Belanger’s background and abusive litigation.

[
3
]

Belanger in January 2024 attempted to insert himself as an “
amicus curiae
” in a debt-related proceeding involving unrelated third-party debtors:
Dimsdale #1
. In response, in
Dimsdale #1
at para
36
, Belanger was prohibited from acting as a litigation representative or being involved in other person’s litigation in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench. Belanger was also banned from physically entering any Alberta courthouse, except if authorized by a court order, or if he was personally appearing in a proceeding, because of his record of abusive, disruptive, and bullying behaviour in Alberta courthouses:
Dimsdale #1
at paras
32-36
.

[
4
]

In
Dimsdale #1
at para
41
, I invited ATB Financial [ATB] to initiate a
Judicature Act
, RSA 2000, c J-2 ss 23-23.1 application to impose indefinite prospective court access restrictions on Belanger that would require Belanger obtain permission – “leave” – prior to initiating or continuing litigation in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench. On April 19, 2024 Counsel for ATB indicated ATB would make that application. I then issued
Belanger (Re)
,
2024 ABKB 239
which at paras
8-11
[
Belanger #1
] set the deadlines for a document-only process to conduct ATB’s application, following this Court’s usual practices:
Unrau v National Dental Examining Board
,
2019 ABQB 283
at paras
565-570
[
Unrau #2
].

[
5
]

ATB submitted its written application and supporting affidavit evidence on May 21, 2024. The same day my office received an email from Belanger that stated in whole:

My most respected Blair, I do so as of my faith asseverate the following private unlisted video: https://youtu.be/QnIv3_cN9XU

I do pray you accept this as my sincere confession of faith and what I base my belief upon.

Subsequently in a second email on June 7, 2024, Belanger claimed him producing materials in writing is “... discrimination upon a physical disability of carpal tunnel syndrome ...”. Belanger provided no evidence to substantiate this condition.

[
6
]

Belanger’s deadline to make reply written argument and affidavit evidence was June 11, 2024. Nothing other than Belanger’s emails were received by this date. I, therefore, conclude that Belanger’s only response to the ATB
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 application is his YouTube video. Now that all submissions have been received, the decision that follows evaluates whether court access restrictions should be imposed on Belanger, and, if so, what should be their scope.

II.        The Law

[
7
]

The current approach by the Court of King’s Bench of Alberta to when this Court may impose prospective court access restrictions pursuant to
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 was recently confirmed by the Court of Appeal of Alberta in
Weidenfeld v Alberta (Minister of Seniors, Community and Social Services)
,
2023 ABCA 353
. Guiding principles include:

1.         whether a person should be subject to prospective litigation gatekeeping pursuant to
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 is a backwards looking exercise that focuses on the record of the abusive litigant(s);

2.         that record may include activities in other jurisdictions and before tribunals;

3.         litigation and litigant management steps require the Court to identify certain forms of abusive activity itemized in
Judicature Act
s 23(2) and detailed in case law such as
Unrau v National Dental Examining Board
,
2019 ABQB 283
[
Unrau #2
];

4.         abusive litigation conduct must be “persistent”;

5.         when evaluating whether court access restrictions should be imposed, “focused” evidence is required, rather than “... an encyclopedia of every last detail about the litigant’s litigation history ...”; and

6.         court access restrictions are a “last ditch” step that may only be imposed after other litigation management approaches have failed, and when less intrusive alternatives, such as case management, are ineffective.

III.       The Parties’ Submissions

A.        ATB Financial

[
8
]

ATB’s application seeks to prohibit Belanger from instituting proceedings in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench, including appeals and applications for leave to appeal, directly, or in relation to other persons. ATB seeks full indemnity costs for its application.

[
9
]

ATB grounds its application on two sets of data. First, ATB points to the extensive record of identified court proceedings and decisions, including
Meads
, and as reviewed in
Dinsdale #1
.

[
10
]

ATB’s application is supported by the May 21, 2024 Affidavit of Heather Gertner that provides a documentary record of Belanger’s interference in the
Dimsdale #1
proceeding. The Affidavit includes:

1.         correspondence by letter and email;

2.         that Belanger personally prepared a YouTube video “To Private men and women acting as Alberta Treasury Board Directors” in 2023 that purported to negate debts owed by a third party “minister”;

3.         transcripts of proceedings where Belanger was involved, purporting to act as an “
amicus curiae
” litigation representative; and

4.         that a second YouTube video from Belanger was posted on March 17, 2024 that responds to and rejects
Dimsdale #1
.

[
11
]

Ms. Gertner’s Affidavit correlates with and expands on this Court’s findings in
Dimsdale #1
at paras
9-21
. ATB concludes three important conclusions result from this information: (1) stereotypic OPCA strategies were advanced in the
Dimsdale #1
proceeding; and (2) Belanger was the directing mind behind that; and (3) Belanger acted as an unauthorized in-court representative.

[
12
]

In brief, ATB argues that the involvement of Belanger and events in the
Dimsdale #1
simply extend a long-standing pattern of OPCA-based litigation misconduct by Belanger. ATB provides a comprehensive chronological review of Belanger’s decades-long litigation misconduct and failure that illustrates Belanger’s repeated, persistent litigation misconduct.

[
13
]

ATB points to Belanger’s record and identifies multiple bases for why indefinite prospective court access restrictions are appropriate:

1.         Belanger is a notorious OPCA promoter and user, with a well-documented, decades-long history of abusive litigation, OPCA-related misconduct, and criminal activity. Belanger has persisted in these abusive activities, despite the consistent failure of these concepts, and detailed court rebuttals. The result has been harm to both Belanger’s clientele, and targeted litigants.

2.         Belanger is an experienced litigation participant with an extensive record of breaching and/or disregarding rules of court, and court orders, including acting as an unauthorized litigation representative in multiple court proceedings across Canada.

3.         Belanger’s litigation exhibits persistent and repeated attempts to re-litigate issues and makes hopeless claims.

4.         Belanger targets lawyers, judges, litigants, and government officials in a manner intended to retaliate and intimidate. His litigation activities are diverse, both in jurisdiction and subject matter. Belanger directly and by proxy litigates for improper purposes.

5.         Belanger’s record of persistent, repeated litigation misconduct, direct and by proxies, supports that he will engage in abusive litigation, unless steps are taken to control his activities.

[
14
]

ATB argues that Belanger satisfies the well-established criteria for indefinite court access restrictions, as recently summarized in
Liu v Kadiri
,
2024 ABKB 271
at para
32
. Belanger’s activities exhibit repeated and persistent instances of abusive litigation indicia identified in
Judicature Act
s 23(2) and case law including
Chutskoff v Bonora
,
2014 ABQB 389
, leave to appeal dismissed
2014 ABCA 444
, and
Unrau #2
. Further, Belanger’s employing Strawman Theory and foisted unilateral agreement OPCA concepts in his broader litigation, but also the
Dinsdale #1
debt litigation establishes a
prima facie
presumption that Belanger’s litigation activities have an ulterior, bad faith purpose.

[
15
]

Given all these factors, the court access restrictions proposed by ATB are both reasonable and necessary, not simply to protect the Courts and targeted litigants, but also the persons that Belanger preys upon with his purported assistance, who end up worse off as the result of Belanger’s interference.

B.        Belanger

[
16
]

As previously indicated, Belanger did not make any documentary submissions. Instead, he sent my office by email the URL to a 78-minute-long YouTube video titled “Private Chamber’s session with Blair Nixon the man acting associate Chief Justice Alberta”. Belanger has directly ignored the instructions of this Court in how he would participate in ATB’s
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 application. An Internet video is not evidence, and Belanger styling this as a “Chamber’s session” does not make his video a court appearance of any kind.

[
17
]

Legally, this recording is a nothing. However, I am mindful that in
Pintea v Johns
,
2017 SCC 23
at para
4
the Supreme Court of Canada endorsed the Canadian Judicial Council
Statement of Principles on Self-Represented Litigants and Accused Persons
[
Statement
], and the
Statement
instructs that self-represented persons, like Belanger, have special privileged status under the law, and, for example, are not subject to the rules of procedure and evidence in the same way, to ensure those rules do not “... unjustly hinder the legal interests of self-represented persons.” I have, for that reason, reviewed Belanger’s video. In taking that step I put no weight on Belanger’s unsupported claims he cannot write and prepare documents. Those claims are quite absurd, given the volume of documentary material created by Belanger identified in the ATB materials.

[
18
]

Belanger’s video does not respond to
Belanger (Re)
#1
directly, ATB’s submissions and evidence, or the
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 process conducted by the Alberta Court of King’s Bench. Instead, Belanger presents CERI pseudolaw concepts, difficult to interpret Bible-based arguments, and a diverse range of claims in a rambling stream of consciousness. There is nothing new, in a legal context. Belanger just rehashes his CERI claims. I will not summarize the whole content of the video, but instead highlight a number of points that illustrate why Belanger ought to be subject to court access restrictions. In a critical sense, Belanger has proven the case against himself with his own words.

[
19
]

Despite the detailed response to and rebuttal of Belanger’s pseudolaw claims in
Dimsdale #1
and other reported cases, and ATB’s detailed submissions and evidence, Belanger re-argues the same points. Particularly relevant is that Belanger immediately begins making Strawman Theory claims that a birth certificate is a banknote that fraudulently created a link with a corporate entity, a “person”. He asserts his “Belanger” name is a fraud. International bankers have seized and claimed Canada as an abandoned ship in Admiralty Law. Canada is a “dead corporation bankrupt entity”. Belanger goes on at some length about the imaginary “birth bond” bank account, and stock market activities associated with the Strawman and court proceedings. Belanger states he refuses to cooperate and participate with court proceedings because that would accept a contract, his secret Strawman bank account would be billed, and Belanger would thus be a sinner. Belanger makes the stereotypical Strawman Theory claims that all upper-case letter names identify a non-human “dead” entity.

[
20
]

Belanger without any foundation or authority rejects the Court’s conclusion in
Dimsdale #1
that categorized his debt-elimination scheme in that matter as abusive pseudolaw. He simply repeats his CERI-based King James Bible claims. Belanger also rejects he can be limited in his court representation activities, because of he is a man of God. He points to the King James Bible as giving him authority to act to intervene with “... all men and women that wish to free themselves from a religious fraud ...”, i.e., Canadian legislation and common law, and government authority. Belanger openly states he breaches and disobeys Canadian law, such as those which regulates motor vehicles, because under God’s law he can do as he wants, pointing to the purportedly binding definitions in law dictionaries.

[
21
]

Belanger specifically denounces the authorities on which this Court has relied in
Dimsdale #1
and
Belanger #1
:

... I’m intimidated and nuisanced and obstructed with Donald Netolitzky and his slander defamation, his gossip and rumour, all based on the obiter dicta of John Rooke. I’ve never met any of these men. I’ve never had any standing before them. ... Donald Netolitzky is getting paid to do it. He’s collecting a wage writing 53 pages just on me ...

Notably, Belanger provides no documentary basis to support this bald allegation.

[
22
]

Much of Belanger’s videos describes his secret conspiratorial knowledge of how the world really works. These claims are, bluntly, dubious on their face. Some are offensive. For example, Belanger describes how as a young man he lived in Beverly Hills with the famous composer and conductor Leonard Bernstein and his family. Belanger lied and said he was Jewish, and subsequently was taught by Rabbis who first examined him physically to confirm he was circumcised. That (supposedly) proved Belanger’s Jewish identity, so the Rabbis then revealed how the Christian Bible was intentionally distorted by Jews to ensure Christians would believe government had true authority, when it did not.

[
23
]

These Rabbis then explained Jews - international Zionist bankers - had schemed and then bankrupted all governments worldwide during the 1929 stock market crash and great depression, seized the public’s gold, and then enslaved gentiles with “people’s flesh registered with whole life policies upon their life estates” – a variation on Strawman Theory concepts. Belanger subsequently elaborates that Jewish law classifies gentiles as animals, who can properly be deceived, and “even murdered and eaten”. Belanger says he cannot be called an anti-Semite, because what he teaches is the truth.

[
24
]

In additional to unpleasant and racist conspiracy claims, Belanger grounds his submission in a series of narratives. Belanger never points to any instance where his CERI pseudolaw scheme has been successful and/or accepted by any court. Instead, he describes how he has haphazardly in social gatherings met legally trained persons like lawyers and judges. These people are amazed and astonished by Belanger’s knowledge and insights, and then admit the secret truth about how government and courts lack legitimate authority. Belanger purports to associate with important government, court, and military persons, name dropping no less than former-US president Donald Trump at one point.

[
25
]

Another such example is Belanger claims that when his secret legal knowledge was revealed to his cousin, an experienced Alberta lawyer, that lawyer “... quit the bar, she was so disgusted over the fraud that I had exposed her to ...”. At another point Belanger states “John Haley, the Queen’s Bodyguard” in 2006 arrested him, but a 33
rd
degree Mason Knights Templar Shriner Warden from Saskatchewan phoned Haley, explained CERI pseudolaw, and then Haley disclosed that an unnamed Crown Prosecutor had confirmed CERI pseudolaw “travelling” claims and said:

Oh my god. You’ve broken three sections of the
Criminal Code
. If that man decides to charge you, I can’t defend you. You’re on your own. You’re going to lose your pension, you’re going to lose your job, you’re going to get a criminal record, and your reputation as the Queen’s Bodyguard is shot.

[
26
]

At this point Belanger forgave Haley, and the charges against Belanger were dropped. Perhaps these claims impress Belanger’s customers, but for the purposes of a court process they are inadmissible hearsay, and, beyond that, patently absurd. Crown Prosecutors defend no-one. Their job is to conduct prosecutions, not defend accused persons.

[
27
]

The closest Belanger comes to an explanation of why he has special legal authority is a vague claim that in 2011 seven Alberta Court of Justice judges “got disqualified” when “witnesses” to unspecified Belanger legal proceedings wrote the Chief Judge of that Court declaring that Belanger was “intimidated, nuisanced, and obstructed”, and Belanger was forced to be a “sinner”, despite his “Liberty in Christ”. Naturally, these are Strawman Theory claims. Belanger explains that meant these “disqualified” judges engaged in criminal offenses as part of a larger conspiracy with the Crown Prosecutors. However, Belanger “forgave them” and did not take legal action.

[
28
]

At this point Belanger’s “disqualified judges” narrative takes a strange turn. Belanger claims circa 2013 to have talked to a “Chambers Clerk” at the Alberta Court of Justice, who revealed that the “Assistant Chief Judge”, John Rooke, would not reply to Belanger, because:

... I don’t think Mr. Rooke’s going to want to meet with you. I said well how about any other Justice in the province of Alberta. I’d like to meet with them to discuss this matter, it’s quite serious. And she said I don’t think any of the judges in Alberta will want to meet with you. And I said well why is that and she said well they’re all in the meeting right now with risk management and the meeting is about you.

By the grace of God this clerk revealed what was taking place as a result of seven judges getting disqualified that had never happened before in the history of the bar where they were disqualified by intimidating the man to violate his faith in Christ, even the Pope got to hear about that. 2013 modus proprio all of a sudden all the Roman curia judges and officers of the Roman curia are now liable for their acts and crimes against humanity, before that there was a blind eye and the Vatican would cover up and protect them. Not so anymore. You go to wonder why there was a meeting with risk management in every judge Alberta about me. It’s because my faith and belief in Christ, and my unwillingness to bow and submit to their questions and their intimidation had never been encountered before and they had to censure me, stomp on me, so I did not multiply and others would learn about their faith and pick up their Bible. ...

[
29
]

Belanger’s claim here is patently absurd. First, now retired Associate Chief Justice Rooke was never a Justice of the Alberta Court of Justice, then the Provincial Court of Alberta. Second, the idea that the actions of judicial officers would trigger province wide “risk management” implications ignores that principle of judicial immunity, which Belanger should be very well aware of, given he has participated in unsuccessful Federal Court litigation where claims of against Associate Chief Justice Rooke were rejected on that exact basis as having no ground in law, and being an abuse of court:
Williams v Rooke
, T-2015-18 (FC). I do not believe it is necessary to engage in a detailed tracing of how Alberta Courts do not fall within the Vatican’s infrastructure and administration. Further, Belanger’s explanations of the basis of court authority are also inconsistent, since earlier in his YouTube video Belanger concluded that my authority flows from the UK Monarch’s Coronation Oath and “Defender of the Faith” status, rather than fealty to the Pope. So which is it?

[
30
]

I make a negative inference on how at various points Belanger claims to have documentary records to prove his points. As I noted, Belanger has provided no affidavit materials to support his claims. More specifically, if Belanger’s special status is from some Alberta court proceedings where judges were disqualified, then Belanger should support those claims with court documents and records. None were provided. If what Belanger claims is true, court records exist. His failure to provide anything except rambling, racist, conspiratorial hearsay and “just so” stories demonstrate that Belanger has no excuse for his conduct. To the degree he is potentially genuinely ignorant, that is intentionally so.

[
31
]

The other broad finding of fact and law that I take from Belanger’s “submissions”, such as they are, is that no good conduct can be anticipated from Belanger. He is an unrepentant scofflaw who has had the opportunity to educate himself, but, instead, has “doubled down” on his CERI pseudolaw schemes. He has openly declared he will not follow Canadian law and court procedure. He rejects prior Court decisions, including
Dimsdale #1
where he is prohibited from acting as an in-court representative in Alberta courts. All these factors mean Belanger will not be affected by conventional court litigation and litigant management steps. That Belanger personally engages in these abusive activities is bad enough. However, he is an unrepentant pseudolaw promoter and guru, and with the result he has harmed many others with his “assistance” and “ministry”. All that favours court intervention.

IV.       Analysis

A.        Facts

[
32
]

I generally accept the Applicant’s affidavit evidence. This Court has separately in
Dimsdale #1
at paras
22-29
reviewed Belanger’s problematic litigation record, and his persistent and ongoing use of abusive OPCA concepts. Belanger appears to complain about this Court’s reliance on its own jurisprudence as factually false and defamatory. I put no weight on that argument, since Belanger did not provide even one documented instance of an error in decisions that have rejected Belanger- and CERI-affiliated litigation.

[
33
]

For the same reason, I reject Belanger’s complaints that the Netolitzky, “Strawman” article is unreliable. That academic publication cites no less than 226 separate sources, most of which are documentary court records and decisions where Belanger was involved, or Internet resources created by Belanger personally. I conclude that since Belanger could not identify a single factual error in Netolitzky, “Strawman”, that his complaint does not concern the accuracy of that academic article, so much as Belanger does not like its conclusions.

[
34
]

Belanger also in his YouTube recording complained that the author, Dr. Donald J. Netolitzky KC, was paid “a wage” to create Netolitzky, “Strawman”. I see no evidence to substantiate that assertion; and I infer it is false. While Dr. Netolitzky is the Complex Litigant Management Counsel for the Alberta Court of King’s Bench, his duties do not include preparing academic publications such as Netolitzky, “Strawman”. Instead, he is a self-described “hobbyist academic” with a very peculiar area of study.

[
35
]

Further, as I have previously reviewed, in his YouTube video Belanger openly admits to his illegal activities, and that he has promoted and employed pseudolaw in his own and others’ abusive litigation, legal, and criminal activities.

[
36
]

In summary, the factual landscape of Belanger’s court and litigation-related activities are not in dispute. In the interest of judicial economy, and mindful of the direction of Stratas JA in
Canada v Olumide
,
2017 FCA 42
at paras
35-40
, that when evaluating abusive litigants, “focused” evidence is necessary, rather than “... an encyclopedia of every last detail about the litigant’s litigation history ...”, I highlight certain key points:

1.         Belanger has been promoting pseudolaw concepts Canada-wide for at least 25 years, personally, and via proxies. He is utterly unrepentant concerning the resulting waste and injury he has caused to government, private institutions, the courts, and individuals, including his so-called church member “ministers”.

2.         Belanger promises he will continue to ignore Canadian law, court orders, and interfere in legal processes, including as an unauthorized and/or prohibited in-court representative and legal advisor.

3.         Belanger has an extensive history of initiating abusive litigation against government actors, and especially court personnel, lawyers, and law enforcement. That includes both civil and attempted criminal litigation. Belanger exploits
Criminal Code
, RSC 1985, c C-46 ss 504, 507.1 private information processes to retaliate and harass.

4.         Belanger also harasses and bullies others by pseudolaw claims and threats.

5.         Belanger attaches himself to and victimizes vulnerable persons, for example an institutionalized senior citizen whose capacity was reduced after suffering several strokes:
Haig v Haig
, Edmonton 4803 136428 (Alta KB).

6.         Belanger has an extensive record of criminal activity, including motor vehicle, drug, drug trafficking, and weapons offences. Belanger is explicit; he is not subject to criminal law authority because of his so-called religion-based immunities.

7.         Belanger has a well-documented record of himself and his followers disrupting court events and proceedings, to the point that security intervention was required.

8.         Belanger personally and via proxies communicates pseudolaw threats to government, court, and law enforcement. I conclude Belanger’s intention is to bully and abuse via these communications. This pattern is ongoing; during his YouTube video Belanger describes how he is currently directing irregular and harassing communications to the Alberta Court of Justice Clerks.

[
37
]

Belanger’s persistent and repeated use of Strawman Theory is also highly relevant to evaluate his status. Strawman Theory is so notoriously false that anyone who employs Strawman Theory is presumed to do so in bad faith, and for abusive, ulterior purposes:
Fiander v Mills
,
2015 NLCA 31
at paras
37-40
;
Rothweiler v Payette
,
2018 ABQB 288
at paras
6-21
;
Unrau #2
at para
180
. I conclude that presumption is especially relevant to Belanger, whose CERI variation on Strawman Theory has been rebutted and rejected by this Court on many occasions: e.g.,
Potvin (Re)
,
2019 ABQB 785
;
R v Berg
,
2019 ABQB 541
;
CP (Re)
,
2019 ABQB 388
.

[
38
]

There is no question Belanger should be subject to court access restrictions, given his decades-long record of abusing Canadian courts directly and via proxies. Belanger is not manageable by any lesser step because he simply rejects any authority other than what he says are his absolute religious rights that he can force on governments, institutions, and individuals who are required to “accommodate” his supraconstitutional international treaty rights. The remaining issue, therefore, is what should be the scope of litigation and litigant management steps in relation to this person?

B.        Court Access Restrictions

[
39
]

Belanger is already subject to limits on being involved in other person’s litigation, his access to physical Alberta courthouses, and his communications with this Court:
Dimsdale #1
. I conclude these prohibitions should continue, but will be consolidated and incorporated into the Order issued on the basis of this decision.

[
40
]

There is no question that Belanger should be required to seek leave prior to initiating or continuing any civil litigation in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench pursuant to
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1. He is precisely the kind of malignant abusive person whose repeated and persistent litigation activities must be evaluated prior to filing to avoid abuse of the Court, and to preserve “access to justice”:
British Columbia (Attorney General) v Council of Canadians with Disabilities
,
2022 SCC 27
at para
1
. The court access restrictions against Belanger should be global, since Belanger’s record demonstrates he abuses court processes in relation to many different subjects and litigation targets.

[
41
]

This Court has the jurisdiction under its inherent authority to control its processes, which includes its ability to conduct pre-filing review of criminal appeal processes entering the Court:
R v Tican
,
2024 ABCA 163
. Belanger has an extensive criminal conviction record, and claims he is not subject to criminal law and sanctions. I therefore extend the leave to file requirement for any criminal law subject appeal by Belanger to the Alberta Court of King’s Bench, since abusive appeals of this kind can be anticipated.

[
42
]

Belanger has a long history of abusing
Criminal Code
ss 504, 507.1 private information processes to attack government, law enforcement, institutions, and court personnel. The law in Canada is unsettled as to whether a court can impose a pre-submission leave screening process on private informations, and if so, what court would conduct that step:
Unrau #2
at paras
872-881
. However, this Court has previously imposed a lawyer representation requirement to participate in private informations (
Unrau #2
at para
881
), including for other members of CERI specifically because of Belanger and CERI members documented frequent abuse of the private information procedure. This same step is appropriate for Belanger. I note that
Jonsson v Lymer
,
2020 ABCA 167
is not relevant in this context because: (1) that decision relates to civil litigation, and (2) the
Criminal Code
s 507.1 pre-enquete procedure demonstrates that no constitutional right exists for a private person to initiate criminal proceedings. That authority belongs solely to the Crown.

[
43
]

Belanger has a well-documented and problematic record of litigation misconduct in civil and criminal proceedings before the Alberta Court of Justice. Belanger in his YouTube video openly boasted of how he currently has many people writing pseudolaw claims targeting the Alberta Court of Justice Sherwood Park Clerk of the Court on his direction. This Court has the jurisdiction under
Judicature Act
s 23.1(6) to impose court access restrictions that are binding on itself, but also the Alberta Court of Justice. I conclude this is an instance where that step is warranted, particularly since Belanger is openly claiming he is abusing that Court as well, and that he is not subject to the legislation, court rules, and the common law that govern any Alberta court process.

[
44
]

I also conclude, on that basis, the Alberta Court of King’s Bench communications restrictions imposed on Belanger in
Dimsdale #1
should equally apply to Belanger and the Alberta Court of Justice.

[
45
]

Based on the evidence before me and my analysis of the law, I conclude that Belanger is a “vexatious litigation”, pursuant to
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1, and an abusive litigant who requires this Court exercise its inherent jurisdiction to control its processes, and therefore Order as follows.

1.         The Representation, Court Access, and Communications Restriction Order of March 13, 2024 in
ATB Financial v Dimsdale Auto Parts Ltd
and Elliot James Edward McDavid
, Action No. 2303 10871 is vacated, but its prohibitions and requirements continued in this decision.

2.         Edward Jay Robin Belanger shall only communicate with the Alberta Court of King’s Bench and the Alberta Court of Justice using the name “Edward Jay Robin Belanger”, and not using initials, an alternative name structure, or a pseudonym.

3.         Edward Jay Robin Belanger is prohibited from commencing, or attempting to commence, or continuing, any appeal, action, application, or proceeding in:

(i)         the Court of King’s Bench of Alberta, on his own behalf, or on behalf of any other person or estate, without an Order of the Chief Justice or Associate Chief Justice of the Court of King’s Bench of Alberta, or her or his designate, and

(ii)        the Alberta Court of Justice, on his own behalf, or on behalf of any other person or estate, without an Order of the Chief Justice or Deputy Chief Justice, or her or his designate.

4.         To commence or continue an action, an appeal including a criminal law subject appeal, an application, or other proceeding in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench, Edward Jay Robin Belanger must first submit an Application to the Chief Justice or Associate Chief Justice, or her or his designate. If such an Application is made:

(i)         The Chief Justice or Associate Chief Justice of the Court of King’s Bench, or her or his designate, may, at any time, direct that notice of an Application to commence or continue an appeal, action, application, or proceeding be given to any other person;

(ii)        Any Application shall be made in writing;

(iii)       Any Application to commence or continue any appeal, action, application, or proceeding must be accompanied by an affidavit:

a) Attaching a copy of the Order arising from this Memorandum of Decision that restricts Edward Jay Robin Belanger’s access to the Court of King’s Bench of Alberta;

b) Attaching a copy of the action, appeal, pleading, application, or process that Edward Jay Robin Belanger proposes to issue or file or continue;

c) Deposing fully and completely to the facts and circumstances surrounding the proposed claim or proceeding, so as to demonstrate that the proceeding is not an abuse of process, and that there are reasonable grounds for it;

d) Indicating whether Edward Jay Robin Belanger ever previously sued some or all of the Defendants or Respondents in any jurisdiction or Court, and, if so, providing full particulars;

e) Undertaking that, if leave is granted, the authorized appeal, pleading, application or process, the Order granting leave to proceed, and the affidavit in support of the Order will promptly be served on the Defendants or Respondents; and

(iv)       The Chief Justice or Associate Chief Justice, or her or his designate, may:

a) Require the Application for leave to, or the Court on its own motion, give notice of the proposed claim or proceeding and the opportunity to make submissions on the proposed claim or proceeding, if they so choose, to:

(3) the Attorneys General of Alberta and Canada;

c) Hear and dispose of the leave Application in open Court.

5.         To commence or continue an action, application, or other proceeding in the Alberta Court of Justice, Edward Jay Robin Belanger must first submit an Application to the Chief Justice or Deputy Chief Justice, or her or his designate. If such an Application is made:

(iii)       Any Application to commence or continue any action, application, or proceeding must be accompanied by an affidavit:

d) Indicating whether Edward Jay Robin Belanger ever previously sued some or all of the Defendants or Respondents in any jurisdiction or Court, and, if so, providing full particulars;

e) Undertaking that, if leave is granted, the authorized action, application, or process, the Order granting leave to proceed, and the affidavit in support of the Order will promptly be served on the Defendants or Respondents; and

(iv)       The Chief Justice or Deputy Chief Justice of the Court of Justice, or her or his designate, may:

V.        Costs

[
47
]

ATB has sought costs of its Application on a solicitor and client full indemnity basis. While ATB has been entirely successful, the interest of bringing this litigation to a close favours a lump sum award, since abusive litigants such as Belanger frequently use costs processes to continue their litigation and impose additional expense on litigants and waste Court resources. This Court has therefore adopted the principle in
Fiander v Mills
,
2015 NLCA 31
that when faced with abusive litigants, a lump sum award is appropriate to bring problematic litigation to a timely and conclusive endpoint: e.g.,
Uhrik v Barata
,
2023 ABKB 517
;
Uhrik v Terrigno
,
2023 ABKB 223
;
Rana v Rana
,
2022 ABQB 139
, leave to appeal denied
2022 ABCA 179
;
2022 ABCA 306
, leave to appeal to SCC refused, 40505 (9 March 2023);
Doniger v Law Society of Alberta
,
2021 ABQB 200
.

[
48
]

In light of ATB’s complete success, and the very substantial and detailed submissions and supporting evidence provided by ATB, I conclude that Belanger shall pay ATB costs of $8,000, forthwith.

VI.       Conclusion

[
49
]

Belanger is a “vexatious litigant”, and is subject to court access and communications restrictions with the Alberta Court of King’s Bench and Alberta Court of Justice. Belanger is prohibited from attending Alberta Courthouses except where he is a court proceeding participant. Belanger is also prohibited from acting as any kind of legal representative in the Alberta Court of King’s Bench or Alberta Court of Justice, or in operating in a lawyer-like capacity in litigation that involves those Courts. Belanger requires a lawyer to submit any future
Criminal Code
ss 504, 507.1 private informations.

[
50
]

I thank Counsel for ATB for her careful and detailed submissions and materials. These were model example for how to conduct and support a
Judicature Act
ss 23-23.1 application.

[
51
]

Dimsdale #1
, that he calls “very harsh” and “discriminatory”, and in breach of his (purported) rights under the

. Belanger has already been instructed on how to respond to that; his remedy is with the Alberta Court of Appeal:

at para
43
.

[

]

Further, I caution Belanger on his future interactions with this Court. His CERI and King’s James Bible pseudolaw claims have been rejected, repeatedly and categorically. He was given the opportunity to prove he has some valid basis for his claims. Belanger did not even provide any evidence, other than a “private” YouTube video he called a “Chambers session”. So, Belanger has had his chance. This Court’s procedural fairness obligations are discharged.

]

Dimsdale #1
and this decision. First, Belanger may seek a remedy with the Alberta Court of Appeal. The second is to stop all pseudolaw activities that, directly or indirectly, involve the Alberta Court of King’s Bench. Rule
10.49(1) of the
Alberta Rules of Court
for each instance where he is involved in litigation or communicates with this Court and raises OPCA concepts and strategies. At this point Belanger has no adequate excuse for any more OPCA activities with the Alberta Court of King’s Bench, either direct, or via litigation proxies.

]

To ensure Belanger is entirely clear on the implications for him of future pseudolaw activities that involve this Court, any
Rule
10.49(1)
penalty amounts imposed are debts to the Government of Alberta, and may be collected and enforced by Government of Alberta processes. Following this Court’s usual process, if Belanger engages in pseudolaw-based misconduct and/or abuse of this Court, the penalties he is assessed will increase with each instance of bad conduct without an adequate excuse:

at para
